Thai Traditional Medicine Assistant Course (330 Hours) | Sukho Ayothaya Khon Kaen
Study the 330-hour Thai Traditional Medicine Assistant course at Sukho Ayothaya Khon Kaen. Graduate with a certificate and take the next step to register as a health establishment service provider.
